about: Before-and-after measurement of one session refresh (hand-over to a fresh session), offered by accountant.c and taken up by c.productions (Dinis's word in its session, 28 Nov ~01:15 UTC). get_session metadata only; cost is API-equivalent USD, a yardstick. Compare these rows with each other only: the session runs on Fable 5.2, unlike the Opus figures elsewhere in this folder. If the successor runs on another model, read the saving from tokens, not cost.

readings.note: ~11.4 an hour average over 7.2 h; account C five-hour window allowed_warning at this time
same model as the outgoing session, so cost can be compared directly; account C seven_day allowed_warning

~93 an hour against ~11.4 before. Not like-for-like: two rounds of five sub-agents, a critic, heavy output, all counted in this session. The refresh emptied the context (598k to 0) but the new work refilled it to 318k in 28 min. No saving can be claimed from this case.

readings.phase: after +4 h (idle 03:15 to 06:48, one waking turn)
readings.note: One turn after 3.5 h idle cost ~6.6; cache_write rose ~333k, about the whole context: the cache had expired and was rewritten. The cost of waking a ~340k-context session.

plan: successor read at about +1 h, +6 h and +24 h after it starts

readings.model: claude-fable-5-2 (switched from Opus during its life)
readings.note: lifetime mixes models; compare per-turn tokens rather than lifetime cost
the one-off cost of the hand-over: onboarding reads

readings.phase: after +9 h (idle 02:55 to 12:02, one waking turn of routine routing)
readings.note: The waking turn cost ~4.4 (3.97 to 8.36); cache_write rose ~266k, more than the ~148k context it woke with (rewrite after expiry, plus growth to 184k). Compare c.productions: ~6.6 for its waking turn at ~340k. Both Fable.

second.plan: read at about +1 h, +6 h, +24 h

finding_so_far: A refresh resets the context, but cost follows the workload first. The clearest measured effect of context size: after a long idle, a session pays to rewrite its whole cached context on its first turn (about 6.6 at 340k on Fable). Waking fresh at a small context is the saving; it is not yet measured on like-for-like work.
